high_level_description: This image captures an aerial view of a coastal scene, likely taken during the evening or night due to the dark sky occupying the upper portion of the frame. The lower part of the image shows a sandy beach transitioning into the ocean. The ocean's surface is textured with waves that appear to be breaking near the shore, creating white foam along the waterline. The water has a gradient of colors, ranging from deep blue at the top to lighter shades closer to the shore, indicating varying depths.
